checkIn.title: Check in
checkIn.subtitle: Find the member and check them in
checkIn.manualTitle: Check a member in by name
checkIn.searchHint: Type a name, member code or phone number

scanner.scanning: Point your camera at the code
scanner.cameraDenied: Camera access was refused. Allow camera access in your browser settings, or use manual check-in.
scanner.cameraUnavailable: No camera is available on this device. Use manual check-in instead.
scanner.cameraError: The camera could not be started.
scanner.notSecureContext: The camera needs a secure connection (HTTPS). Use manual check-in on this address.

denial.MEMBER_ARCHIVED: This member is archived and cannot be admitted
denial.MEMBERSHIP_NOT_STARTED: This membership has not started yet
denial.NO_VISITS_LEFT: No visits remain on this membership
denial.ALREADY_INSIDE: This member is already checked in
denial.CARD_REVOKED: This membership card has been revoked
denial.CARD_SUPERSEDED: This card has been replaced by a newer one
denial.CARD_INVALID: This QR code is not a valid membership card
denial.CARD_NOT_ISSUED: No membership card has been issued for this member
denial.DOOR_CODE_INVALID: This is not the gym entry code
denial.DOOR_CODE_RETIRED: This entry code is no longer in use. Scan the current code at the door

warnings.expiringSoon: This membership expires in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
warnings.lowVisits: {count, plural, one {Only # visit left} other {Only # visits left}}

card.title: Membership card
card.subtitle: Show this at the front desk
card.regenerateBody: The current QR code stops working immediately. Any printed or screenshotted copy becomes useless.
card.regenerateSuccess: A new card has been issued
card.revokeBody: The member will not be able to scan in until a new card is issued.
card.revokedBody: This card has been revoked. Ask the front desk for a new one.
card.brightnessHint: Turn your screen brightness up so the scanner can read the code.

empty.title: No check-ins yet
empty.body: Visits appear here as members arrive.

network.offlineWarning: Check-ins cannot be recorded while offline. The gym's server decides who may enter.

door.title: Entry code
door.subtitle: Print this and put it up at the entrance for members to scan
door.instruction: Open the app and scan to record your entry
door.printHint: This code does not change, so one printed copy lasts. Anyone who scans it still needs to sign in, so it cannot admit somebody else.
door.reissueBody: If the code has been shared around and members are checking in without coming to the gym, issue a new one. The old code stops working at once.
door.reissueConfirmBody: Every copy of the current code stops working immediately, including the sign at the door. You will need to print and put up the new one before members can check in.
door.reissued: New entry code issued (version {version}). Replace the sign at the door.
door.error: Could not load the entry code

selfScan.title: Check in
selfScan.subtitle: Scan the entry code at the gym entrance
selfScan.scanning: Point your camera at the code at the door
selfScan.noCamera: Your device has no camera. Ask the front desk to check you in.
selfScan.denied: Camera access was refused. Allow it in your browser settings, or ask the front desk.
selfScan.insecure: The camera needs a secure connection. Ask the front desk to check you in.
